title: Systems
description: The systems you sell (Zigbee, KNX, HDL Buspro). A system's topology decides which checks and addresses apply.

field.name: Name
field.abbreviationHint: Badge text, up to 6 characters, e.g. ZB. Empty for a dot.
field.colorHint: Badge colour, e.g. #1f6feb. Empty for none.
field.activeHint: Inactive systems are hidden from the catalog but keep their products.
field.advancedHint: Switched voltage and reserve. The defaults (230 V, 20 %) suit most systems.
field.defaultBusCurrentMaHint: A bus power supply can deliver only so much current. This is what one device draws when its product has no value of its own (e.g. KNX 10 mA). Empty: such devices do not count against the supply.
field.nominalVoltageHint: The mains voltage the devices switch (e.g. 230 V), not the bus voltage. Converts the power of needs (W) into current (A) for limits in A when a channel has no voltage of its own.
field.reservePercentHint: Capacity kept free: amber above 100 % − reserve, red when exceeded.
field.busDevicesMaxHint: Default maximum devices on one bus line. Empty = not checked.
field.topologyHint: How devices of this system connect: a bus (bus current, devices per line), wireless (places at a gateway) or neither.
field.defaultWirelessPlacesUsedHint: A gateway connects only a limited number of devices, its places. This is how many places one device takes when its product has no value of its own (usually 1). Empty: such devices do not count against the gateway's limit.
field.addressingHint: The device addresses of this system on the Networks tab: KNX or HDL Buspro for a bus, EUI-64 (Zigbee IEEE) for wireless.
